title: skills(pm-dispatch): the Claim template carries an Account: line beside Session:, paid inside the ratchet
body:
Fixes #20103
Clause-②: no

## Summary

The `Claim:` comment template now carries the seat's GitHub account beside the session id, so a thread reader can tell which account handles a card without leaving the thread (every content write leaves as the fleet bot, so the comment's author field says nothing). Ownership stays the session id: the new line is a derived view of the card's assignee, a mismatch on a live claim is a half-state the owning seat corrects at its next write, and takeover step ③ carries the new account in the same stroke as step ② swaps the assignee. Text only, two files, every path under `.claude/**` (Tier S — stays DRAFT; no ready flip, no enqueue, no auto-merge).

Implemented as the card's 「What lands」 items 1 and 2 under the maintainer's 「确认」 / 「而且这个优先派发」 quoted on the card. Item 3 is untouched by design: no dev-agent definition edit, no patrol row, no report-JSON field, no gate.

## What changed — per file (line counts before → after; both ceilings unchanged)

| File | Before | After | Ceiling |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` | 319 | 319 | 319 |
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md` | 183 | 183 | 183 |

**SKILL.md 模板与表 — the `Claim:` template (+1 line, 104 B, inside the fenced block so byte-cap exempt):** immediately after the `Session:` line, a new line `Account: LOGIN (the seat's linked user as GET /user answers it; always the card's assignee)` — LOGIN standing for the backticked placeholder spelled the same way as the template's other placeholders.

**SKILL.md ratchet payment (−1 line):** deleted the 入口与角色 bullet 「开轮互斥的四读数、开轮标记与章程触碰核对见 `references/seat-lifecycle.md` 〈开轮互斥〉。」 (118 B). Where its content still lives: the rules themselves — the four readings, the round-open marker and the charter-touch check — are `references/seat-lifecycle.md` 〈开轮互斥〉 (lines 7–22 of that file); the routing is already carried by the 阶段细则索引 row for `references/seat-lifecycle.md` (读者 「每个座位每次 fire:开轮互斥读数前、收班前」, 承载 「开轮互斥 · …」). The ratchet script's own history note for the 819 → 319 cut records those rules as relocated verbatim (「Relocation, not deletion」), so the bullet was a leftover pointer duplicating the index row. Not touched: the `batch` row, 报告契约, the four-axis block (md5 `abff5f852c8fd09b79ec0623439aa4f0` unchanged; it shifts up one line), the 路径分叉 block.

**execution-duties.md 〈认领〉 — two lines rewritten IN PLACE (net 0; the file has headroom 0 and a 120-byte cap):**

- Identity sentence (114 B → 117 B): 「- 共享身份下 assignee 只答有无认领;身份只认正文 session ID,⛔ 不认作者字段,接管同此。」 → 「- 归属 = session ID,⛔ 不认作者字段;`Account:` 派生自 assignee,不等即半态、持卡席下笔补正。」 It keeps the ownership key (归属 = session ID) and the author-field prohibition verbatim, and adds the card's sentence: derived view of the assignee, mismatch = half-state, the owning seat corrects it at its next write. Three clauses left the line because each is stated elsewhere: 「共享身份下 assignee 只答有无认领」 (AGENTS.md: the assignee field is only a presence bit; SKILL.md 状态模型 rows), 「正文」 (SKILL.md 全体座位的不变量: 归属 = 文本里的 session ID), 「接管同此」 (takeover ③ below carries the new session).
- Takeover ②③ (118 B → 119 B): 「- ② assignee 同笔换人(`--unassign 旧 --assign 新`);③ 新 `Claim:`:新 session、续用分支与远程 sha。」 → 「- ② assignee 同笔换人(`--unassign`+`--assign`);③ 新 `Claim:`:新 session 与 `Account:`,续用分支与 sha。」 The 旧/新 flag values and 「远程」 were the only bytes that could pay for `Account:` under the cap (④ on the next line still names 「旧分支最后已 push 的 sha」).

## Measured against the 120-byte cap (why the dispatch's suggested wording was not used)

The suggested identity sentence measures 141 B and every takeover variant that keeps 「旧/新」 and 「远程」 beside `Account:` measures 125–134 B (`LC_ALL=C awk length`). No line in 〈认领〉 can be freed at ≤ 120 B without splicing two rules onto one line, so the half-state sentence landed inside the identity line rather than beside it.

## Follow-up — noted, not built

A `check-half-states.mjs` patrol row for 「newest live claim's `Account:` ≠ assignee」 would make the half-state mechanically visible; per the card it needs the maintainer's own words naming it, so it is recorded here only.

## Acceptance notes

- The dispatch's mechanism assumption (b) named a `check-clause2-carriers.mjs` binding `CLAIM_HANDOVER_SENTENCE_LINES` to 〈认领〉 text: no such script exists on `origin/main` at `8d76c2d` (`git grep` over `scripts/` finds neither name), and no script pins a 〈认领〉 sentence by bytes — measured before rewriting.
- Sibling cards #20084 and #20088 remain open and each pay their own +1 in SKILL.md; whichever PR lands later merges `origin/main` first and re-runs the ratchet. If a sibling deletes this same pointer line, the later tree lands at 320 and must re-pay.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

### 改了什么

PM 的认领评论模板新增一行 `Account:`,写席位登录的 GitHub 账号(与卡片 assignee 相同),放在 `Session:` 旁边;执行席细则的〈认领〉一节改两行:`Account:` 只是 assignee 的派生视图、归属仍是 session ID、两者不一致即半状态由持卡席下次写入时改正;接管协议第 ③ 步的新认领同笔带上新账号。SKILL.md 多出的一行由删掉一条指向 `seat-lifecycle.md` 的重复索引行来支付,两个文件行数不变。

### 为什么改

所有写入都以车队机器人身份落地,评论作者栏看不出是哪个席位账号在处理;目前账号只在座位贴标题、卡片 assignee 和 PR assignee 上,认领评论本身没有。加这一行后,读线程的人不必离开线程就知道是谁在做。

### 风险与代价(含回滚)

纯文本改动,无门禁、无脚本、无 JSON 字段变化;本地 23 个门禁族全绿。代价是删掉一条重复的索引行(内容与路由都仍在索引表和 `seat-lifecycle.md` 里)和〈认领〉两行的压缩改写(超出 120 字节上限的措辞已实测排除)。回滚 = revert 本 PR,一次 revert 即可,无数据迁移。

### 席位意见

(留空)

### 你要做的

本 PR 是 Tier S 受管面,保持草稿:由 skills 席按达档复核 PASS 后落地;你无需操作。若要让「`Account:` ≠ assignee」进入半状态巡查,请单独用你的原话点名一条巡查行,那是后续单。
